description:
README claimed each keymap.c does `#include "peterhoeg.c"` for combo
introspection. Wrong three ways: peterhoeg.c and keymap_dk.c are compiled
via SRC in rules.mk, and the textually included file is combos.inc, which
is where key_combos[] has to live.

Commits:
  d930bdc docs: correct how the shared code is pulled in
title: Correct README's account of how the shared code is included
